title: [Peek] Arrow keys navigate between files instead of scrolling or changing caret
author: daverayment

confidence.rationale: The issue author identified the regression and an open upstream PR now directly fixes the exact hotkey handling mistake.

linked_work.relevance: Active upstream fix for this issue.

judgment.rationale: The report already points to the regression source (#48293), and open PR #50472 now removes plain arrow keys from the global Peek keyboard hook while adding Alt+Left/Alt+Right navigation shortcuts. That PR directly addresses the issue’s expected behavior for interactive previewers.
evidence: The issue precisely reproduces the bug across Markdown, text, HTML, PDF, and ZIP previewers and attributes the regression to #48293.
MainWindow.xaml.cs currently handles unmodified Left/Right/Up/Down inside the low-level Peek keyboard hook and turns them into previous/next file navigation.
PR #50472 explicitly removes arrow keys from that handler and documents restored scrolling, text navigation, and ZIP interaction behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Track the issue through PR #50472 instead of opening a separate fix design.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is already an active upstream PR covering the exact regression and the same owning files.

issue_context.summary: Peek’s low-level keyboard hook currently steals plain arrow keys from interactive previewers, but an open upstream PR already removes that behavior and replaces file navigation with Alt+Left/Alt+Right.
known_information: The issue was filed by an assignee/collaborator and already identifies the regression as introduced by #48293.
The affected previews include text, HTML, PDF, and ZIP content where arrow keys should scroll, move caret focus, or navigate within the previewer.
PR #50472 is open and touches the same Peek MainWindow hook and title-bar focus behavior.
inferences: No separate competing implementation plan is needed while PR #50472 remains current.
issue_context.analysis: This issue is already in flight upstream, so the maintainer-facing artifact should point to the active PR rather than reopening design work.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, the automated triage comment, and the linked open PR #50472.
Inspected src/modules/peek/Peek.UI/PeekXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs to confirm plain arrow keys are currently hooked globally.

comment.body: This issue is already covered by PR #50472, which removes plain arrow keys from the global Peek keyboard hook and restores scrolling/text interaction inside interactive previewers. Please keep the fix discussion and validation on that PR so this issue does not fork into duplicate implementation work.
